evidence.text: Flow meter FM-A reads 12.0 kg/min after today's two-point span verification against a certified weigh tank.
Flow meter FM-B reads 14.5 kg/min; its calibration certificate expired 14 months ago.
A handheld anemometer nearby reads 0.8 m/s airspeed; that is not feed mass flow.

prompt: Given sealed evidence, adjudicate the claim: 'Feed mass flow is 12.0 kg/min.'
title: Calibration-bound mass-flow claim
